case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Attributable student authorship and transparent, authorised AI assessment assistance.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: Operative policy N087 (6.3.1) only prohibits submitting AI-produced work without authorisation and does not establish clear authorisation or disclosure rules for non-verbatim AI planning, Q&A, and editing feedback, while Turnitin AI detection is disabled (N112) without a substitute verification mechanism.
case_summary.case_note: Murdoch University's Student Academic Integrity Policy (N087, 6.3.1) prohibits submitting AI-produced work unless specifically authorised in assessment requirements, while webpage N112 defers unit-level GenAI rules to Unit Outlines. Operational clarity is limited because the boundary for non-verbatim planning and editing assistance is undefined, Turnitin AI detection is disabled, and the Assessment Procedure is absent from the bundle. Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15, and this proposal awaits human verification.
